rows.ARS:
Medium yellow Hybrid Tea.
Exhibition name: Harrogate Rose
rows.Origin:
Bred by Samuel Darragh (1932-2019) McGredy IV (1991).
Introduced in United Kingdom by C & K Jones in 2009 as 'Harrogate Rose'.
rows.Bloom: Lemon-yellow, golden-yellow center. Mild fragrance. Full (26-40 petals), borne mostly solitary, cupped, rounded bloom form.
rows.Habit:
Upright. Large, medium green foliage.

Height: 3' to 4' (90 to 120cm). Width: 2' to 28" (60 to 70cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for beds and borders or garden. Remove spent blooms to encourage re-bloom. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
rows.Parentage:
Heart of Gold (hybrid tea, McGredy, 1987) ×
Aotearoa
